_comment: Secrets bound by deploy/backend.cloudbuild.yaml whose substitution defaults to EMPTY and
which a deploy lane does not pass. add_secret skips empties, so such an omission produces a
service missing that environment variable with no error anywhere.
Substitutions with a non-empty default are bound regardless and are deliberately not
scripts/ci/check-deploy-secret-coverage.py fails on any omission not listed, and on a listed
entry that no longer matches reality. Adding an entry requires a reason.
